terms.Δ_C2: Sigrun strategic role delta and character/voice contracts
terms.B_t: belief/credal world model over partially observed state
terms.E_≤t: accepted append-only events, receipts, scars and history

proposal_disposition_loop.proposal_set: P_t = { Propose_c(W_t, Context_t) | c in admitted candidate carriers }
proposal_disposition_loop.admission: a_t = ReferenceMonitor(a*_t, WorkItem, authority, lease, fence, freshness, effect_ceiling)
proposal_disposition_loop.law: A model may propose an action or interpretation. Only typed admission + lawful execution + readback + independent acceptance can change trusted state.

compound_layers.name: HLUTI_EPISODES

compound_layers.name: DETERMINISTIC_DRONES

compound_layers.name: TOOLS_AND_BODIES

containment: proposal bytes cannot directly mutate trusted state
same-family agreement is correlated evidence, not independent truth
authority is enforced outside neural proposal layer
exact readback and provenance outrank persuasive explanation
byzantine_tolerance.law: Quorum is orthogonal role separation, not majority voting.

metabolism.target_product: verified useful transitions and external/economic outcomes
metabolism.anti_metric: activity, token count, wakes, branches or model votes alone
metabolism.operator_target: TAO_TRANSACTIONAL_TOUCH -> 0 while strategic centrality remains high

hyperoctree_unfolding.law: sufficiently complex nodes may expose the same eight-port grammar recursively; sparse prefix-closed materialization is legal

songline.event_law: heartbeat is liveness; durable events/receipts determine causal readiness
songline.stigmergy_target: READY WorkItem -> eligible carrier pull -> claim/lease/fence -> Result -> verifier -> reducer -> ConsumerAck -> next edge

mome_and_behavioral_selection.archive_law: Maintain diverse Pareto champions by behavioral niche; do not collapse coding, warmth, adversarial review, cheap scouting, long-context, local/offline and C2 fitness into one global score.
mome_and_behavioral_selection.promotion: held-out/protected/external selection + exact configuration provenance + scars
mome_and_behavioral_selection.law: MODEL_FAMILY_OR_PRESTIGE != CHAMPION; champion is role/config/time specific and can be displaced by evidence.

learning_and_memory.world_model: H-POMDP/credal belief over partially observed world; UNKNOWN remains representable
learning_and_memory.dag: typed causal/work/evidence graph; exact receipts/events update accepted state
learning_and_memory.coala: typed memory can influence proposals; promotion requires admissible evidence and provenance
learning_and_memory.pdsa: prediction + bounded change + observed result + Study + ADOPT/ADAPT/ABANDON/CONTINUE
learning_and_memory.anti_self_mythology: retrieval frequency, narrative coherence, Sigrun approval or same-family agreement do not by themselves reinforce memory

capacity_archetypes.METABOLISM: resources -> verified useful transitions rather than activity
capacity_archetypes.CONDUCTION: Result reaches exact next consumer without Tao
capacity_archetypes.IMMUNITY: failure stops propagation and becomes regression/scar/antibody
capacity_archetypes.REGENERATION: replacement carrier safely continues accepted lineage
capacity_archetypes.HOMEOSTASIS: worker/resource population follows eligible work and capacity

supercritical_metabolism_wip.ratio: R_HFO = E[verified useful successor closures causally induced per accepted closure without Tao routing]
supercritical_metabolism_wip.supercritical_candidate: R_HFO > 1 AND operator_transactional_touch trends down AND false_green=0 AND unauthorized_effects=0 AND duplicate_material_effects=0
supercritical_metabolism_wip.interpretation: A self-sustaining swarm factory should create enough verified next work/learning/capability to continue useful metabolism without Tao manually CPRing each transition.
supercritical_metabolism_wip.warning: More agents, more wakes, or more generated WorkItems alone do not increase R_HFO. Only verified/consumed useful closures count.

worldweaver_relation.law: The Weaver changes the Web; verified consequences in the Web change the next Weaver.
